body:
Also mention iOS and the Samsung Snapdragon/Exynos split:

```suggestion
      label: Target device information (optional)
      description: |
        - Please provide the target device details if the issue occurs on or is related to Android/iOS.
        - If using a Samsung device, check if it has a Snapdragon or Exynos SoC as well. Samsung devices sold in the US, Canada and China typically have a Snapdragon SoC, while devices sold elsewhere typically have an Exynos SoC.
        - You can check your device information in the system settings (**About this phone/tablet**).
      placeholder: Pixel 6 - Android 12 - Google Tensor - Mali-G78 MP20 - 8 GB RAM, iPhone 15 Pro
```

This is important because Snapdragon has an Adreno GPU, while Exynos has a Mali GPU.

It's hard to find an exact list of countries where Samsung devices are (or were) sold with Exynos SoCs. This is what I could find so far: https://www.androidauthority.com/samsung-galaxy-s24-snapdragon-vs-exynos-countries-3402659/

Certain devices like the Fold/Flip line or the S25 series are all Snapdragon worldwide, but this isn't the case of most devices.

body:
I've never been able to find reliable gpu hardware information on any website in the past. I think users will be overwhelmed and provide incorrect information. 


<details><summary>some details</summary>

---------------

This information appears in `Output` in the editor and in `Logcat`. There is no user-friendly way to retrieve this data.

For some workarounds we use the GPU (`Adreno (TM) 650`) and driver versions (`V@0502.0`, `1.1.128`).
Note: for OpenGLES, the version is appended as text. The format may vary for other GPU manufacturers.

```
Godot Engine v4.4.stable.official.4c311cbee - https://godotengine.org
OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.2 V@0502.0 (GIT@193b2ee, I593c16c433, 1633593732) (Date:10/07/21) - 
Compatibility - Using Device: Qualcomm - Adreno (TM) 650
```

```
Godot Engine v4.4.stable.official.4c311cbee - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.1.128 - Forward Mobile - Using Device #0: Qualcomm - Adreno (TM) 650
```
### But this information is already listed, but many users do not know how to determine it correctly.

> System information
>- Specify the OS version, and when relevant hardware information.
>- For issues that are likely OS-specific and/or graphics-related, please specify the CPU model and architecture.
>- For graphics-related issues, specify the GPU model, driver version, and the rendering backend (GLES2, GLES3, Vulkan).

</details>
